title: First Digital Product Ideas: Make It Small Enough to Finish
description: If your first digital product takes more than 2 weeks to build, make it smaller. Turn a 20-lesson course into a ready kit, a 200-page guide into a 10-page guide with one worked example, and an app into a spreadsheet that does the math. Small enough to finish means small enough to test and sell.
alt_text: Comparison of too-big first digital products and right-size versions: a 20-lesson video course becomes a ready kit with a Start Here page, a 200-page guide becomes a 10-page guide with one worked example, an app becomes a spreadsheet that does the math.

title: Views But No Sales? Find the Leak in Your Etsy or Gumroad Listing
description: Etsy and Gumroad sellers: every sale passes 4 steps. Seen, clicked, read the page, bought. Seen but not clicked? Your title and image don't match the search. Clicked but left fast? Your first line doesn't say who it's for. Read but didn't buy? A doubt is left unanswered. Fix the first leak only, then wait.
alt_text: Sales funnel for Etsy and Gumroad sellers with 4 steps, seen, clicked, read the page, bought, and the leak to check at each step.

title: Does ChatGPT Recommend Your Store? 13 AI Tests for Shopify Owners
description: Shopify owners: does AI find your store without your name, recommend you when shoppers ask what to buy, and describe you correctly? The AI Shopping Readiness Kit gives you 13 ready tests, including 5 blind tests, that you paste into any AI assistant. The free ChatGPT works. For Shopify and any online store.
alt_text: Pin for Shopify owners showing three kinds of AI tests: discovery, does AI find you without your name, including 5 blind tests; recommendation, does it recommend you; understanding, does it describe you correctly. AI Shopping Readiness Kit.

title: Product Page Audit: Find the Weakest Part of Your Page First
description: Store owners: answer 25 quick questions about your product page and get a score out of 100, with a score for each section. See your strengths, weak spots and a priority list of what to fix first, then score again and compare. Inside the AI Shopping Readiness Kit, for Shopify, Etsy, Gumroad and any online store.
alt_text: Product page audit steps for store owners: answer 25 quick questions, get a score for each section and a total out of 100, see what to fix first, fix and score again. AI Shopping Readiness Kit.

title: 90-Day Plan to Launch Your First Digital Product: The Whole Map
description: From idea to launch in 13 weeks and 6 gates: find a scored idea, prove people want it from your desk, build a small first version, get found with keywords and content, convert with a product page and welcome emails, then improve one change at a time. About 5 to 8 hours a week, with a special skill or without one. Inside The Digital Product System: From Idea to Sales.

title: Free Tools to Sell Digital Products: Start With $0
description: You don't need paid tools for your first digital product. Sell and email with Gumroad, plan and track in Google Sheets, see the searches that bring people to you in Google Search Console, and design covers and pins with Canva's free plan. One free tool per job, fewer logins, fewer things to break.
alt_text: Free toolbox for selling a first digital product: Gumroad to sell and email, Google Sheets to plan and track, Google Search Console to get found, Canva free plan to design. Cost to start: $0.

title: Product Listing Checklist for WooCommerce, Wix and Etsy Sellers
description: Not on Shopify? The same rules apply on WooCommerce, Etsy, Wix, Squarespace and your own site. Use a title that names the product, open with who it's for and the result, add a short details table, and answer real doubts in an FAQ. Shoppers and AI assistants read every platform the same way.
alt_text: Product listing checklist for WooCommerce, Wix, Etsy and Squarespace sellers: a title that names the product, first lines with who it's for and the result, a short details table, an FAQ for real doubts.

description: A product idea is a starting point, not a product. title: How to Choose Marketing Channels for a Digital Product: Pick 2
description: Posting everywhere is why nothing works. Score each channel 1 to 3 on four questions: are your buyers there, can you make the format, does it fit your weekly hours, and is there a clear path to your product? The top 2 win. Add a third only when both run smoothly. Save this matrix and fill it in.
alt_text: Fill-in channel matrix for digital product marketing: score Search, Pinterest, Communities, Short video and Your own blog 1 to 3 on four questions, then keep the top 2 channels.

title: Weekly Schedule to Grow a Digital Product Business in 6 Hours
description: Only 6 hours a week? Here's the whole week: Monday plan, Tuesday create one main piece, Wednesday make the supporting pieces, Thursday publish and share, Friday measure what worked, and one hour any day for your product and emails. Fixed blocks remove the daily what-should-I-do question. The weekly system inside The Digital Product System: From Idea to Sales.

title: Does ChatGPT Find Your Shopify Store Without Your Name? Free Test
description: Shopify owners: try this blind test today. Ask an AI assistant what's a good [product type] for [your buyer], without typing your store name. Then check: did it mention you, did it recommend you, did it describe you correctly? Use the same assistant and the same prompt every time so you can compare after each change.

title: How to Validate a Digital Product Idea Without Interviews
description: Myth: to test an idea, you must interview people. Fact: you can test it from your desk. Answer 5 questions using real reviews, threads and searches: is the problem real, do people spend time or money on it, do similar products sell, is interest steady, do current options disappoint? 4 to 5 yes, build it. The Validation Checklist inside The Digital Product System: From Idea to Sales.
alt_text: Myth versus fact pin: you can test a digital product idea from your desk with 5 validation questions, and results 4 to 5 yes build it, 2 to 3 yes change the offer, 0 to 1 yes pick another idea.
